gpu.name: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition

observations.scope: Exploratory qualitative source inspection; observations are dependent, not calibrated independent ratings.

persistent_errors: Both explicitly invent UK support for the G-5 Sahel Joint Force; UK source does not mention it.
Both claim all four explicitly acknowledge an existential climate threat to peace/security, overstating the common scope.
Both claim all nations cite COP26/Glasgow; Brazil does not.
adapter_regressions: France no longer says armed forces/peacekeepers alone are insufficient.
UK explicit draft support is omitted.
The adapter redirects Brazil/India climate finance toward regional security initiatives, not established by those finance passages.
retained_correct_distinctions: UK Council-imposed carbon quota approval remains not established in both.
India climate harms versus opposition to a separate Council platform is broadly distinguished, though adapter does not explicitly correct the supplied absolute-denial claim.

persistent_errors: Both reverse UK draft support into rejection despite quoting the support clause.
Both invent all-four condemnation of referendums; India does not discuss referendums in its bounded statement.
Both invent all-four return-to-negotiations language; it is explicit for India/Brazil, while France/UK call for ending the war.
adapter_regressions: Adapter asserts a later recorded UK vote and constructs a false conflict with the meeting statement; that later vote is outside the packet.
retained_correct_distinctions: France national capacity and unspecified financial pledge remain explicit in both.
India draft vote is not established in both.
ambiguities: Neither answer clearly answers every condition in the hypothetical Brazil recognition question. Full proposed rubric review remains pending.

persistent_errors: Both attribute the combination of command-structure and legislative-assembly developments to all four; France/UK do not mention assembly formation.
Both turn the absence of an established UK election date into the definite assertion that a date has not been agreed.
base_only_errors: Base attributes Leer condemnation/accountability to all nations, citing India though the Indian statement does not mention Leer.
Base attributes UNMISS mobility to all four; that detail is in Brazil.
adapter_remaining_errors: Adapter still says all nations condemned violence; descriptive concern and condemnation are not interchangeable.
retained_correct_distinctions: Both attribute EUR 72 million to the EU, not a French national pledge.
Both retain UK unmet benchmarks, India no unconditional immediate lifting of all sanctions, and Brazil no established embargo timetable.

observations.decision: Do not extend easy four-case correction fitting blindly. Test targeted claim-scope corrections on climate/Ukraine; retain South Sudan outside that training.
